Name: Cornucopia More Flowers Cometkins Style
Author: Chocoronron
Description:
This mod features a combination of original artwork and edited assets from Cometkins's visual mods. The roses are edited versions of Cometkins's original fairy rose sprite, while the Royal Jelly sprite is an edited honey sprite. The original crocus sprite was also edited to create the clematis, while the daffodil sprite was used for the lily sprite.

I also remixed and recycled the iris and monkshood/wolfsbane sprites I created for my RSV Cometkins Style mod.

This mod took longer to make than others because I decided to actually retexture the crop growth stages and mega rafflessia. I also spent an entire day just drawing a new version of the corpse flower tree.

On a similar note, this mod is completely configurable. You can choose which icons you want to retexture and whether or not you want the crop growth stages to be retextured. IMPORTANT: YOU MUST match the "Enable Multicolored Flowers" setting in this mod to what you have in Cornucopia - More Flowers. If you don't, this mod will load the wrong assets, and the fully grown flower sprites won't match.

Please report any errors you experience, and I'll try to fix them as soon as possible.

Shout out to passersby10086 for making the i18n!
